title: Theater and Smokestack(s)
content: Just came across you guys today, and I'm only posting because my dream had an "other" quality about it. For me, there was an outdoor shopping area as well as the big theater connected to the rest of a mall. In the backdrop of the outdoor shopping area were either one, one and a half, or two old brick smokestacks with white lettering going vertically on the smokestack. I can't remember exactly what it said, but it may have been the Goodrich smokestacks in Akron, Ohio after trying my hand at googling this morning. I've never been to been to Ohio at all, nor seen smokestacks with letter similar to this IRL. I'm not sure if they have relevance or if I took note of them because of the the oddness. Anyhow, back to the layout. Upon entering the theater which had a HUGE atrium, there were these super long escalators to one side that went up to a second-level balcony that overlooked the atrium and from where you would enter the separate theater rooms. The atrium had a sense of being an older building that was once a train or transit area, but had been "upgraded" or repurposed. It had pretty large copper or Ironworks tubing that ran along the walls and ceilings, and the ceiling was almost like the had been gutted/stripped to show the old building materials for aesthics during the repurposing. The theater was mostly empty for me. I started roaming and made it to the back hallways that were almost spot on to the back halls of the AMC theater post in this sub. There I ran into an old, stooped man and we had a conversation of some importance (don't remember what), and then I don't remember anything else or I woke up. Anyone else have smokestacks or old tubing??
